card.name: Just before fenofibrate is named
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (to, between, e.g., comma, open bracket) right before the drug name fenofibrate or fenofibric acid is expected, in fibrate-related warnings and interaction text.

modes.description: A word like 'to' or 'between' that leads into fenofibrate or fenofibric acid.
